title: Model-agnostic Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting for time series
abstract: arXiv:2608.14054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting with pretrained foundation models has demonstrated strong zero-shot capabilities. However, achieving optimal performance on time series with short or negligible historical data in domain-specific applications typically requires adaptation via either fine-tuning or RAG. While fine-tuning is effective, it incurs substantial computational costs. This work explores RAG within univariate time series (Retrieval Augmented Generation) as a more efficient alternative, in particular RAF (Retrieval Augmented Forecasting), and introduces RAEF (Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting), a model-agnostic method built upon RAF. RAEF incorporates key refinements to the retrieval and aggregation mechanisms: (1) direct retrieval in input-space rather than embedding-space, reducing inference overhead, and (2) concatenation-based aggregation that preserves temporal structure instead of averaging. translated_title: 模型无关的检索增强扩展时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 基于预训练基础模型的时间序列预测已展现出强大的零样本能力。然而，在特定领域应用中，对于历史数据较短或可忽略的时间序列，要实现最优性能通常需要通过微调或RAG（检索增强生成）进行适应。虽然微调有效，但会带来大量计算成本。本研究探讨了在单变量时间序列中应用RAG（检索增强生成）作为一种更高效的替代方案，特别是RAF（检索增强预测），并引入了RAEF（检索增强扩展预测），这是一种基于RAF构建的模型无关方法。RAEF对检索和聚合机制进行了关键改进：（1）在输入空间而非嵌入空间直接检索，降低推理开销；（2）采用基于拼接的聚合方式，保留时间结构而非简单平均。跨多个数据集的实证评估表明...
tldr: 本文提出RAEF方法，通过输入空间直接检索和拼接式聚合，实现模型无关的低成本检索增强时间序列预测，兼顾效率与准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RAEF, a model-agnostic method that enhances time series forecasting via input-space retrieval and concatenation-based aggregation, achieving efficient and accurate RAG-based prediction.
